starter.title: Creator foundation
starter.description: Build an audience and understand performance from your first links.
starter.reward: Track clicks, conversions, and audience insights.
starter.detail: Build reliable baseline data to understand the content your community values.
starter.requirementOne: Complete your profile and publish at least one link.
starter.requirementTwo: Share a link through one active social channel.
starter.requirementThree: Track basic clicks and unlock behavior.
starter.modelTwo: Identify links and channels with conversion potential.
starter.modelThree: Prepare data for the next earning levels.

growth.title: Audience growth
growth.description: Turn consistent traffic into a qualified follower base.
growth.reward: Prioritize lead capture, offers, and click-based campaigns.
growth.detail: Grow an owned audience before activating direct revenue channels.
growth.requirementOne: Reach 250 valid clicks in the last 30 days.
growth.requirementTwo: Keep at least two links active.
growth.requirementThree: Maintain a consistent click rate across shared channels.
growth.modelOne: Capture leads for newsletters, communities, or waitlists.
growth.modelTwo: Deliver offers and limited content to the right audience.
growth.modelThree: Compare link performance to optimize campaigns.

partner.title: Partners & affiliate
partner.description: Try brand recommendations and offers that fit your community.
partner.reward: Create referral campaigns and track partner performance.
partner.detail: Unlock collaboration campaigns based on traffic quality and content focus.
partner.requirementThree: Have a clear content focus and defined audience.
partner.modelOne: Earn commission from partner referral links.
partner.modelTwo: Offer exclusive benefits to your community.

creator.title: Digital products
creator.description: Package your knowledge, presets, or resources into your own products.
creator.reward: Sell digital resources, premium content, and creator bundles.
creator.detail: Build direct revenue from products your community genuinely needs.
creator.requirementTwo: Have an engaged lead list or community.
creator.requirementThree: Define the product, value proposition, and audience clearly.
creator.modelOne: Sell files, templates, presets, or compact courses.
creator.modelThree: Offer exclusive benefits for loyal followers.

studio.title: Brand studio
studio.description: Coordinate larger, multi-channel campaigns and long-term brand relationships.
studio.reward: Manage brand campaigns, sponsorship packages, and performance reporting.
studio.detail: A level for creators with a clear content system, community, and commercial direction.
studio.requirementTwo: Maintain high performance across multiple campaigns.
studio.requirementThree: Have a brand-ready content portfolio and community.
studio.modelTwo: Create media kits and recurring performance reports.
studio.modelThree: Manage multiple revenue channels in one workspace.
